clues: This city spreads along the Adriatic shore in the north of Italy. It sits at the south tip of a wide flat river plain, on a key coast road.
Warm winds from the south west can bring heat in each season here. Folks call these foehn winds by local names, libeccio and garbino.
Men from Rome founded this city as a colony in 268 BC. They built an arch and a bridge at the start of roads from here.
A famed film maker was born in this city, and his films won fans all round the world. His name is Federico Fellini, a giant of film.
This city is one of the most famed beach resorts in all of Europe. Its first bath house for sea swims first opened way back in 1843.
